text: Every time Virat Kohli stayed not out in a T20 I chased India 1. 18 times 18 victories and now there is someone doing something remarkably similar. His name is Tilak Parma. 12 times he finished not out in a T20 I chased and all 12 times India have won. Remember the Asia Cup final against Pakistan? India needed someone to finish their job and Tilak delivered an unbeaten 69 under enormous pressure.
And honestly, that's phenomenal. These guys deserve every bit of appreciation.
But before we start calling him the next chaze master, there is one statistic you need to hear.
In ODI cricket, whenever Kohli has remained not out while chasing, India have won 32 out of 33 matches.
and that one match India lost

January 2011 port Elizabeth India were chasing 266 against South Africa. A young Virat Kohli was betting beautifully. He was on 87, still at the craze and the South African bowlers couldn't get him out.
But then nature has other plans. The rain arrived, the match stopped.
resumed and then the rain returned.
Eventually, India lost by 48 turns under the Duckwalt Lewis method. South Africa couldn't get Virat out that night. The weather took the victory away from him.
Think about that 32 victories in 33 ODIs changed when he remained unbeaten.
And this is what separates a good record from a legendary career.
Tilag is doing something special, he might become one of India's greatest finishers and I genuinely hope he does.
But Virat Kohli didn't earn the title of Chasemaster in a few incredible innings. He spent more than 15 years building a legacy that speaks for itself.

Tila can create his own history. He can become a legend in his own right. But there will never be another Virat Kohli. Because some players become legends, Virat Kohli becomes the benchmark. Send these to that one friend who has already decided that the next chess master has arrived.
